fieldValues.title: Build: make the change once, in the right place
fieldValues.purpose: The change is made once, in the layer that owns it, in a clean workspace against the right build, and is not lost.
fieldValues.in_scope: Worktrees, the pinned CLI, capability layering, implementation rules (ADR-048), breaking-change choreography.
fieldValues.out_of_scope: Judging and landing the change (Review and land).
